evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Remediate actionable ESLint factory findings in actions/setup/js, including downstream implementation.
intent.acceptance: Partial native facet: signed removal of missing radix diagnostics on global parseInt and Number.parseInt in existing non-test CommonJS files, checked by isolated ESLint 9.39.5 builtin radix/always. No upstream config is loaded. Other radix equivalents, invalid radix values, other factory rules and full validation are not measured.

evidence.opportunity: Immutable modifications to tracked non-test actions/setup/js/*.cjs files after workflow adoption.
filters: Only builtin radix missingRadix diagnostics count; this is a strict partial facet of the frozen factory's require-parseInt-radix rule.
ESLint 9.39.5; CommonJS, latest supported ECMAScript; no upstream modules, configs, scripts or plugins execute.
A separately retained initial plain-object-throw facet has zero known movement; it is not substituted for this radix facet.
Signed immutable first-parent changes; additions, deletions, unsupported file modes and JS parse failures remain unknown.
Native source diagnostics are partial progress, not full lint, regression, behavior or generator-root-cause acceptance.
Corroborated retained output graph joins establish shared contribution, not receipt-verified creation or exclusive causality.
Only known effects enter observed subtotals; complete totals remain null across unknown source assessments.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of digest-checked, bounded immutable Git source facts and retained shared output lineage.

model.architecture: Frozen local native oracle; no upstream code or configuration execution.
model.recommendation: Native partial progress, unknown safeguards, and costs are separate; no keep threshold is inferred.
